**Build passes now.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both, type-check |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Treat unset as `false` |

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18). They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, unless you want that fake warning list trimmed.
